import collections,bisect
S,E=4302,42701
delta=600
ev=[e for e in events if S<=e[2]<=E]
ev.sort(key=lambda x:x[2])
# temporal BFS: reachable(node) = earliest time node became infected
adj=collections.defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in ev: adj[u].append((t,v))
for u in adj: adj[u].sort()
# earliest infection time
best={798:S-1}  # 798 infected "at" start (can use any outgoing edge in window)
import heapq
pq=[(S-1,798)]
# for source, allow any outgoing edge in window (no delta constraint from start)
first=True
while pq:
    t0,u=heapq.heappop(pq)
    if best.get(u,10**9)<t0: continue
    lst=adj[u]
    lo=bisect.bisect_right(lst,(t0,10**9))
    for t,v in lst[lo:]:
        if u!=798 and t-t0>delta: break
        if t<best.get(v,10**9):
            best[v]=t
            heapq.heappush(pq,(t,v))
print("131" , best.get(131))
print("reached",len(best))
print(sorted(best.items(), key=lambda x:x[1])[:30])
